12.t: Working with data: cane toad spread
q: How far had the toads spread after 30 years?
Describe the change in front speed.
The front moved faster and faster: from about 10 to 50 km per year.
Suggest why the toads spread so successfully.
No predators or diseases, lay many eggs, poisonous, eat almost anything.
Toads at the front now have longer legs. Use natural selection to explain why the front speeds up.
Toads with longer legs moved further, reached new areas first and bred together, so long legs became common at the front: each generation is faster.
